# thetalake_role (Data Source)

The role data source enables look up from role name to ID



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the role

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Only included in custom roles. Role creation timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `default` (Boolean) Indicates if this role is the default role
- `description` (String) A description of the role
- `id` (Number) The role ID
- `is_built_in` (Boolean) Indicates if the role is built in or custom
- `number_of_users` (Number) The number of users currently assigned to this role
- `updated_at` (String) Only included in custom roles. Role updated timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
